scope: Entirely fictional personal migration fixture. No real employer, employee, account, conversation or service is represented.

newsletter_facts.text: We shipped Seed Hub to all 1,008 synthetic accounts on October 30.
We completed the first company-wide seed exchange with 480 packets shared.
We published keyboard instructions for every Seed Hub control.
We opened one shared help queue for everyone in the synthetic company.
We scheduled Seed Hub maintenance for November 4 at 09:00 UTC for 2 minutes; saved seed lists remain stored. Save drafts before maintenance.
We need a volunteer editor for translation review; there is no approved completion date.
We added passkey guidance to the personal test account handbook.
We released seed-name search to every synthetic account.
We published the seed-list export guide for every account.
We refreshed orientation materials for all synthetic members.
We published the next-quarter roadmap for everyone to review.
We published the accessibility guide in the shared handbook.
We opened the monthly company-wide feedback form.
We completed the synthetic backup restore rehearsal on October 29.
We published the shared support-hours calendar for November.
We opened a seed-storage workshop to everyone on November 6.
We published a revised seed-exchange etiquette guide.
We published the Seed Hub guide for small screens.
We plan to review translation coverage and publish the rollback guide during November 2 to November 8.
We have no approved release date for offline mode; the date is unconfirmed and the project owner must provide an official response.

faq_questions: Will the November 4 maintenance delete saved seed lists?
Where can people find the accessibility guide?
When will offline mode be released?

announcement.purpose: Explain the scheduled maintenance and action to take beforehand
